replies.tracking_link: You can find the tracking link in your shipping confirmation email. It shows the latest carrier status.
replies.carrier_delay: Carrier scans can pause during transit. If the expected delivery window has passed, please contact support with your order number so a person can investigate.
replies.refund_timing: After a refund is approved, a payment provider may take 5 to 10 business days to post it. We cannot verify a particular refund from this message; please contact support if it has not appeared after that period.
replies.payment_methods: Available payment methods are shown at checkout before you place an order.
